newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada board to examine Westcoast gas tolls.
newsitem.headline: Canada board to examine Westcoast gas tolls.

text.p: Canada's National Energy Board said on Monday it received Westcoast Energy Inc's 1997 toll application, which asks for a 25-percent increase in rates over 1996.
The NEB said, however, that Westcoast plans to file a second application later for new incentive-based tolls to be effective in 1998.
Under the incentive plan, Westcoast's revenue requirement for its British Columbia gas mainline would be fixed for the five-year period from 1997 to 2001.

In estimating its 1997 cost of service, the company used a return on common equity componenet of 11.25 percent, the same as was approved by the NEB for 1996. The 1997 rate of return will be adjusted in accordance with the same decision, the board said.
The capital structure used in the application includes a weighted common equity component of 35 percent, it said.
